name: RealDynLFV
title: A Large-Parallax Benchmark for Real-World Dynamic Light Field Video
overview: RealDynLFV is a benchmark for real-world dynamic light field video with large parallax. It brings together dynamic scenes captured across 5 × 5 synchronized camera views, supporting research in light field video processing and interpolation.
availability: The benchmark dataset and accompanying resources are being prepared for release. Availability updates will be provided on this project page.
